_comment_rewrites: SPA fallback — every unknown path serves index.html so React Router can handle client-side routes (/login, /chat/:slug, /verify/age, etc). Without this Vercel returns 404 for anything that isn't a real file in /dist.
_comment_headers: Long-cache the hashed static assets (Vite renames them on every build, so safe). HTML is no-cache so new deploys are visible immediately.
